title: Flocks Version Info
newVersionDesc: This update includes new capabilities, experience improvements, and fixes. Upgrade to review the highlights.
confirmUpgradeDesc: The service will briefly restart during the upgrade, and the page will refresh automatically when it is ready.
restarting: Service restarting, will auto-refresh when done...
upgradeCompleteDesc: The service confirmed completion. You can close this window.
upgradeFailedDesc: This update could not be confirmed as complete. Check the service status using the details below.
streamInterrupted: The update connection ended before completion. Check the service status before checking for updates again.
streamTimeout: The update connection has not responded for 5 minutes. Check the service status before checking for updates again.
restartTimeout: Service readiness check timed out: {{reason}}. Please refresh manually to confirm status.
restartUnknown: No explicit health-check result was received
dockerModeDesc: You are running Flocks via Docker. In-place upgrade is not available. Please pull the latest image and restart the container to upgrade.
offlineModeDesc: This instance was installed from the offline package (flocks-offline.run); network-based in-place upgrades are disabled. Get the newer package, upload it to the server and run the install command again; data and licenses are kept.
offlineNotChecked: Offline deployment: remote versions are not checked
managedModeDesc: This installation's upgrades are managed by the deployment; the built-in updater will not modify the managed runtime. Use the deployment's upgrade flow or contact an administrator.
